12-Day Turkey Tour with Mediterranean Gulet Cruise
summary:
The 12-Day Turkey Tour & Gulet Cruise combines some of Turkey’s essential cultural stops with three nights sailing the Mediterranean aboard a traditional wooden gulet. Visit Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus and Pamukkale before heading south, where sightseeing gives way to swimming, quiet bays and life on board as the gulet cruises between Marmaris and Fethiye.
Because the cruise operates seasonally, travel dates are planned around scheduled gulet departures, with adjustments possible where needed. Your arrangements include selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, three domestic flights, the 3-night gulet cruise, English-speaking local guides, airport transfers and sightseeing during the land portion.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour & Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Hierapolis Day tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Tour Day tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Marmaris & Gulet Cruise
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Marmaris
Free time to explore the town center and marina
Afternoon boarding of the traditional gulet cruise
Overnight in Marmaris Harbour

itinerary.title: Ekincik Gulf & Dalyan (Blue Voyage)
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard the gulet. Cruise to the beautiful Ekincik Gulf. Optional tour to Dalyan by small boat, including a visit to İztuzu Beach, famous for its Caretta-Caretta turtles, and views of the ancient Kaunos Rock Tombs. Enjoy free time at the mud baths and thermal pools before exploring the fishing town of Dalyan. Return to the gulet by boat. Overnight in Ekincik Gulf.

itinerary.title: Gocek Gulf & Kızıl Island
itinerary.text: Early morning cruise toward the beautiful Gocek Gulf. Enjoy breakfast and a swimming break at Cleopatra Bay, also known as the Sunken Bath, where underwater ruins of an ancient bath can still be seen. Continue to Tersane Island, once used as a Byzantine and Ottoman shipyard. Later, cruise to Kızıl Island. Overnight onboard.

itinerary.title: Fethiye & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: Arrival at Fethiye Harbour in the morning. Optional jeep safari tour around the region. Guests staying onboard can enjoy lunch and swimming at Samanlık Bay. Free time to explore Fethiye, known in ancient times as Telmessos. Disembark from the gulet cruise and transfer to Dalaman Airport for your flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 12-Day Turkey Tour with Blue Voyage?
faqs.a: The 12-Day Turkey Tour with Blue Voyage covers Istanbul, Pamukkale, Ephesus, Cappadocia, Fethiye, and the stunning Turkish Riviera aboard a traditional Blue Cruise. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's unique landscapes, visit the ancient city of Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white terraces, and enjoy several days cruising along Turkey's beautiful Mediterranean coastline. The tour runs for 11 nights and 12 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 12-Day Turkey Tour with Blue Voyage cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,595 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, three domestic flights, Blue Cruise accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights and the Blue Cruise included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes three domestic flights as well as the Blue Cruise portion of the itinerary. The cruise offers a unique opportunity to sail along Turkey's turquoise coastline while visiting secluded bays, islands, and picturesque seaside towns.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes hotel accommodation in carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique properties, along with accommodation aboard a traditional Turkish gulet during the Blue Cruise. Daily breakfast at hotels and meals specified during the cruise are included according to the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 12-day Turkey tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled land tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a combination of history, culture, natural wonders, and coastal relaxation. It combines Turkey's most famous inland attractions with the unforgettable experience of cruising along the Mediterranean coast.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Some boarding and disembarking from the gulet may require light mobility, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What is included in the Blue Cruise experience?
faqs.a: The Blue Cruise includes accommodation aboard a traditional gulet, opportunities for swimming in crystal-clear bays, scenic coastal sailing, and visits to beautiful coves and seaside destinations around the Fethiye region. It is one of the most relaxing and memorable parts of the tour.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 12-Day Turkey Tour with Blue Voyage?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional protection and flexibility.

faqs.q: Is the 12-Day Turkey Tour with Blue Voyage available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The land tour operates throughout the year, while the Blue Cruise operates seasonally, generally between April and October. The itinerary can be customized with additional hotel nights, cabin upgrades, optional excursions, or route modifications. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
